parent_v4.key_refutation: O5 robust-impossibility recovery remained exactly flat from 10 percent to full positive coverage in all 314 eligible static undirected rows

scientific_question: Does restoring directional flow and temporal arrival-order information convert additional positive occurrences into new source discrimination and new robust-impossibility information that static undirected reachability could not recover?

latent_landscapes.reuse: exact v2 7x7 latent A/B fields, geographic neighbourhoods, edge-uniform barrier draws, factor levels and replicate seeds

flow_field.outlet_corner: one of the four grid corners selected by a stable response-independent hash of replicate, autocorrelation and neighbourhood; constant across barrier levels for the same latent base
flow_field.flow_potential: squared Euclidean distance from the outlet corner
flow_field.directed_edge_rule: after geographic, A/B, environmental and barrier filtering, orient each edge from larger flow potential toward smaller flow potential; equal-potential edges, if any, remain bidirectional
flow_field.truth_source: A/B-permissive node in the largest geographic permissive component with maximum flow potential; ties by node ID
flow_field.interpretation: synthetic downstream flow coordinate, not calibrated hydrology

two_parallel_universes.directed: same filtered edges oriented by the frozen flow field

candidate_worlds.truth_world: directed relative_edge_q70 world at the row's barrier level and frozen upstream truth source

positive_observation_design.truth_positive_pool: all non-source nodes reachable in the directed truth world
positive_observation_design.eligibility: at least four non-source truth-reachable nodes
positive_observation_design.spatial_order: reuse the v4 dispersed-farthest-first rule as a frozen observation design; v5 does not retest whether dispersed beats clustered

temporal_evidence.truth_arrival_depth: shortest directed graph distance from truth source
temporal_evidence.candidate_compatibility: for each observed positive anchor, candidate directed shortest-path distance must be finite and <= the anchor's truth arrival depth
temporal_evidence.semantics: reached-by-depth upper bound; propagation depth is structural, not calendar time

primary_outputs: undirected static survivor-world and candidate-source counts by occurrence coverage
directed static survivor-world and candidate-source counts by occurrence coverage
directed temporal survivor-world and candidate-source counts by occurrence coverage
robust-impossibility recovery fraction for all three inference regimes

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least 80 percent of eligible directed truth worlds contain at least one unordered pair of truth-reachable nodes for which exactly one of i->j or j->i is reachable.
In the directed static candidate universe, pooled mean robust-impossibility recovery is nondecreasing with positive coverage and strictly larger at full coverage than at 10 percent coverage.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if monotonicity fails or full-minus-10-percent is <=0.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At full positive coverage, pooled mean surviving candidate-source count is lower in the directed static universe than in the matched undirected universe.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if directed-minus-undirected mean source count is >=0.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At full positive coverage, temporal arrival-depth constraints strictly reduce survivor-world count in at least one eligible row and pooled mean temporal survivor fraction is lower than directed-static survivor fraction.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if no row contracts or the pooled mean contrast is nonnegative.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At full positive coverage, pooled mean robust-impossibility recovery is larger under directed temporal evidence than under directed static positive evidence.
At full positive coverage, pooled mean surviving candidate-source count is lower under directed temporal evidence than under directed static evidence.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if temporal-minus-static mean source count is >=0.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Across all eligible rows, regimes and coverage levels, the truth world survives and no truth-reachable locally permissive node is classified robustly unreachable.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

secondary_outputs: fraction of rows with exact source recovery after directed full positives
fraction with exact source recovery after temporal evidence
median world/source survivor counts in all regimes
relationship between directional asymmetry and temporal contraction
comparison of v4 undirected plateau with the matched v5 undirected control
claim_boundary: The outlet-directed flow field is a synthetic mechanism probe, not a claim about real river or wind direction.
Arrival depth is graph depth, not years or generations.
Candidate-source contraction is not ancestry inference.
Any break of the v4 plateau is conditional on the frozen directed generator and does not establish empirical prevalence.
stop_rules: Do not change the outlet rule after scoring.
Do not add a second directional field to rescue failed hypotheses.
Do not change temporal upper-bound semantics after scoring.
Do not add clustered sampling back into v5 after seeing results.
